vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: same-day-document-drop-plan
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a prompt-only logistics planner for document delivery and contains no executable code, network requests, or data exfiltration logic. It includes explicit safety boundaries in SKILL.md to prevent the agent from requesting or storing sensitive PII (like full tax IDs or account numbers) and correctly disclaims legal or official advice. All files, including skill.json and ACCEPTANCE.md, are consistent with the stated administrative purpose.

llm.summary: This is a prompt-only checklist skill for planning urgent document drop-offs, with no code, network access, credentials, persistence, or hidden behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The requested user inputs, such as address, deadline, document list, and proof needs, are proportionate to planning a document drop-off and include privacy cautions for sensitive identifiers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only three text/JSON files and the manifest declares a document-only prompt flow with no executable code, API requirement, network use, or credentials.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded to logistics and proof planning, with explicit warnings not to provide legal, immigration, tax, medical, banking, courier, or identity-verification advice beyond checking with the official recipient.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, tool modification, memory writes, package installation, or local credential/session use was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is coherent: it helps plan same-day document delivery logistics, recipient verification, proof of delivery, document inventory, and fallback steps.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This skill is appropriate to install if you want a structured logistics checklist for same-day paperwork delivery. Users should still verify addresses, hours, deadlines, intake rules, and original-document requirements directly with the recipient, and avoid sharing unnecessary sensitive numbers or credentials in prompts.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The artifact does identify English-language packaging in skill.json and acceptance checks; this is a localization limitation, but it does not create hidden behavior, data access, execution authority, persistence, or other security-relevant risk.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied static scan reported no security findings, which matches inspection of the artifact files.
